name: ICommand
description: An intention sent to exactly one owning slice.
example: public sealed record CancelOrder(string OrderId) : ICommand;

name: IEvent
description: The common marker accepted as a process trigger or projection fact.
example: Process.StartOn<OrderPlaced>(e => e.OrderId);

name: IDomainEvent
description: An internal accepted fact produced by a slice.
example: public sealed record OrderCancelled(string OrderId) : IDomainEvent;

name: IIntegrationEvent
description: A public fact that can cross a context boundary.
example: public sealed record PaymentConfirmed(string OrderId) : IIntegrationEvent;

name: IntegrationEventAttribute
description: Gives an integration contract its stable name and positive version.
signatures: public sealed class IntegrationEventAttribute(string name) : Attribute
example:
[IntegrationEvent("payments.payment-charged", Version = 1)]
public sealed record PaymentChargedV1(string OrderId, decimal Amount, string Currency) : IIntegrationEvent;

name: Process
description: Stores the trigger, ordered nodes, compensation outcome and structural fingerprint as data.
signatures: public static ProcessBuilder<TEvent> StartOn<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, object> key, [CallerMemberName] string name = "")

name: ProcessBuilder
description: Builds an immutable fluent process; every modifier applies to the last node or outcome.
signatures: public ProcessBuilder<TTrigger> Undo<TCommand>(Func<TTrigger, TCommand> compensation, Attempts? insist = null, Backoff backoff = Backoff.Exponential)
public ProcessBuilder<TTrigger> Undo(Delegate compensation, Attempts? insist = null, Backoff backoff = Backoff.Exponential)
public ProcessBuilder<TTrigger> Retry(Attempts attempts, Backoff backoff = Backoff.Exponential)
public static implicit operator Process(ProcessBuilder<TTrigger> builder)
example:
Process flow = Process.StartOn<OrderPlaced>(e => e.OrderId)
    .Then(Stock.Reserve).Retry(3.Times).Undo(Stock.Release, 20.Times)
    .Then(Payments.Charge).Retry(3.Times, Backoff.Exponential).OrCompensate().Undo(Payments.Refund)
    .Await<PaymentConfirmed>(e => e.OrderId).Within(15.Minutes)
    .Then(Shipping.Ship).NoRetry("the carrier retries on its side")
    .OnCompensated(Orders.Cancel).Retry(10.Times);

name: Backoff
description: Selects immediate, linear or exponential retry delays, capped at one minute.
example: var retry = new RetryPolicy(3.Times, Backoff.Linear);

name: RetryPolicy
description: Describes retries and calculates their delay; Undo supplies the default insistence policy.
signatures: public sealed record RetryPolicy(Attempts Attempts, Backoff Backoff)
public static RetryPolicy Undo { get; } = new(new Attempts(10), Backoff.Exponential);
example: TimeSpan firstDelay = RetryPolicy.Undo.DelayBefore(1);

name: StepRef
description: Names a pure command-producing function and lists any earlier event types it reads.
example:
StepRef step = StepRef.From(Stock.Reserve);
string name = step.Name;

name: ProcessNode
description: The common record for a command step, wait or compensation outcome.
example: foreach (ProcessNode node in flow.Nodes) Console.WriteLine(node);

name: StepNode
description: Holds a step, its undo, explicit policy reasons and behavior after retries run out.
signatures: public sealed record StepNode(StepRef Action, StepRef? Compensation = null, RetryPolicy? Retry = null) : ProcessNode
example:
foreach (var step in flow.Nodes.OfType<StepNode>())
    Console.WriteLine(step.UndoPolicy.Attempts.Count);

name: CompensatedNode
description: Stores the command sent after reverse compensation and its insistence policy.
signatures: public sealed record CompensatedNode(StepRef Action, RetryPolicy? Retry = null) : ProcessNode
example: RetryPolicy? policy = flow.Outcome?.Policy;

name: AwaitNode
description: Stores the awaited event type and optional declared timeout.
signatures: public sealed record AwaitNode(Type Event, TimeSpan? Timeout = null) : ProcessNode
example: var waits = flow.Nodes.OfType<AwaitNode>().Select(wait => wait.Timeout);

name: Result
description: Represents success or a business error through implicit conversions and Match.
signatures: public readonly record struct Result<TOk, TError>

public static implicit operator Result<TOk, TError>(TOk value)

name: HistoryKind
description: Identifies starts, sends, replies, received facts, timeouts, operator actions and final states.
example: var commands = history.Entries.Where(e => e.Kind == HistoryKind.Sent);

name: HistoryEntry
description: Records one boundary observation with its stored payload, step, attempt and outcome or reason.
signatures: public sealed record HistoryEntry(DateTimeOffset At, HistoryKind Kind)
example:
foreach (HistoryEntry entry in history.Entries)
    Console.WriteLine($"{entry.Kind}: {entry.Type}");

name: InstanceHistory
description: Exports an ordered process-instance history with its key and structural fingerprint.
signatures: public sealed record InstanceHistory(string Process, string Key, string Fingerprint, IReadOnlyList<HistoryEntry> Entries)

name: JournalEntry
description: A human-readable observation timestamped using the virtual clock.
signatures: public sealed record JournalEntry(TimeSpan At, string Process, object? Key, string Message)
example: foreach (JournalEntry entry in shop.Journal) Console.WriteLine(entry);

name: ProcessStatus
description: Describes an instance as Running, Awaiting, Completed, Compensated or Suspended.
example:
if (shop.StatusOf(Processes.OrderFulfillment, "A-1") == ProcessStatus.Suspended)
    Console.WriteLine(shop.ReasonOf(Processes.OrderFulfillment, "A-1"));

name: IState
description: The nongeneric marker identifies state; implement the generic contract in application code.
example: public abstract record Order : IState<Order> { /* Initial and Evolve */ }

name: IState<TSelf>
description: Provides the initial snapshot and a pure transition from each accepted domain event.
example:
public static Order Initial { get; } = new None();
public Order Evolve(IDomainEvent e) => e is OrderCancelled ? new Cancelled() : this;

name: Projection
description: Registers pure event-to-view updates; a null result deletes the selected view.
signatures: protected void On<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, object> key, Func<TView?, TEvent, TView?> apply)

name: Publication
description: Maps an internal domain fact to an explicit public contract.
signatures: public abstract class Publication<TDomainEvent, TIntegrationEvent> : IPublicationHandler

name: Slice
description: Owns a command and decides one event or rejection from its keyed state.
signatures: public abstract class Slice<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> : ISliceHandler
public abstract Result<TEvent, TError> Decide(TCommand command, TState state);

name: Decision
description: The runtime returns an accepted domain event or a rejected business error.
signatures: public sealed record Accepted(IDomainEvent Event) : Decision;
public sealed record Rejected(object Error) : Decision;
example:
var decision = await shop.SendAsync(new CancelOrder("A-1"));
if (decision is Decision.Rejected rejected) Console.WriteLine(rejected.Error);

name: Upcaster
description: Maps an older integration contract into the newer version a subscriber consumes.
signatures: public abstract class Upcaster<TFrom, TTo> : IUpcasterHandler

name: Attempts
description: A positive retry count expressed with the C# extension literal Times.
example:
Attempts attempts = 3.Times;
int count = attempts.Count;

name: Literals
description: Adds readable TimeSpan and Attempts properties to integer expressions.

name: UnionAttribute
description: Marks an abstract record whose nested sealed records are its closed cases.

name: WyrdJsonContextAttribute
description: Marks the source-generated application JSON context checked by the serialization analyzers.

name: Invariant
description: Checks the settled runtime, returning null for success or a useful failure explanation.
signatures: public sealed record Invariant(string Name, Func<InMemoryRuntime, string?> Check)
public static IReadOnlyList<Invariant> Defaults { get; } = [ProcessesSettle, NothingNeedsAttention];

name: ProjectionScenario
description: Applies facts in the supplied order and compares a view as stored JSON.
signatures: public ProjectionScenario<TView> Then(object key, TView? expected)

name: ReplayReport
description: Exposes recorded and replayed entries, the first divergence, structural reason and replay error.
example:
report.ThrowIfDiverged();
if (report.Divergence is { } first) Console.WriteLine(first.Index);

name: ReplayDivergence
description: Points to the first unequal entry; a null side means that entry was absent.
signatures: public sealed record ReplayDivergence(int Index, HistoryEntry? Recorded, HistoryEntry? Replayed);
example:
HistoryEntry? expected = report.Divergence?.Recorded;
HistoryEntry? actual = report.Divergence?.Replayed;

name: Scenario
description: Starts a JSON-checked business specification for a slice or projection.
signatures:
public static SliceScenario<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> For<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError>(
Slice<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> slice)
example:
Scenario.For(new ChargePaymentSlice())
    .Given(new PaymentCharged("A-1", 89m))
    .When(new ChargePayment("A-1", 89m))
    .ThenRejected(PaymentError.AlreadyCharged);

name: SimulationOptions
description: Configures runs, seed, hostile probabilities, settling time and bounded greedy shrinking.
signatures: public TimeSpan SettleFor { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromDays(1);
public bool Shrink { get; init; } = true;
example:
var options = new SimulationOptions { Runs = 200, Shrink = true, ShrinkBudget = 200 };
var replay = options.Only(9);

name: Violation
description: Describes a failing seed, invariant, detail and journal, optionally with its reduced future.
signatures: public sealed record Violation(int Seed, string Invariant, string Detail, IReadOnlyList<JournalEntry> Journal)
example:
foreach (Violation failure in report.Violations)
    Console.WriteLine($"{failure.Invariant}: seed {failure.Seed}");

name: ShrunkFuture
description: Contains a smaller failure found within budget, without promising a global minimum.
signatures:
public sealed record ShrunkFuture(
string Detail, IReadOnlyList<string> Perturbations, IReadOnlyList<JournalEntry> Journal, int Replays);
example:
var smallest = report.Violations.First().Shrunk;
var perturbations = smallest?.Perturbations;

name: SimulationReport
description: Exposes explored runs, options and violations and can fail a test with the first case per invariant.
signatures: public sealed class SimulationReport(int runs, SimulationOptions options, IReadOnlyList<Violation> violations)

name: Skuld
description: Explores seeded futures with faults, redelivery and reordering against explicit invariants.
signatures:
public static async Task<SimulationReport> SimulateAsync(
Func<InMemoryRuntime> system,
Func<InMemoryRuntime, Task> scenario,
IReadOnlyList<Invariant> invariants,
SimulationOptions? options = null)

name: SliceScenario
description: Supplies historical facts or an explicit state, then asks the slice to decide a command.
signatures: public sealed class SliceScenario<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError>
public SliceScenario<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> Given(params IDomainEvent[] history)
public SliceScenario<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> GivenState(TState state)
public SliceOutcome<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> When(TCommand command)
example:
Scenario.For(new ChargePaymentSlice())
    .GivenState(new Payment.None())
    .When(new ChargePayment("A-1", 89m))
    .Then(new PaymentCharged("A-1", 89m));

name: SliceOutcome
description: Asserts the accepted event, business rejection or evolved state after a command.
signatures: public sealed class SliceOutcome<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError>
public SliceOutcome<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> Then(TEvent expected)
public SliceOutcome<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> ThenRejected(TError expected)
public SliceOutcome<TCommand, TState, TEvent, TError> ThenState(TState expected)
example:
Scenario.For(new ChargePaymentSlice())
    .When(new ChargePayment("A-1", 89m))
    .Then(new PaymentCharged("A-1", 89m))
    .ThenState(new Payment.Charged(89m));

name: Urd
description: Runs the process against recorded replies and virtual time, checking the first difference.
signatures:
public static async Task<ReplayReport>
    ReplayAsync(Func<InMemoryRuntime> system,
        Process process, InstanceHistory history)

name: WyrdAssertionException
description: Signals a failed scenario, invariant or replay expectation to the test runner.
example: report.ThrowIfViolated(); // throws WyrdAssertionException if any invariant failed
